claim_scope: GSE90063 K562 TF pool 13d GEARS formal adjudication entry. Output: formal supplementary external model-side panel. Target set: context-local 10-TF leave-one-out, not atlas-shared with HCC.
input_space_description: GSE90063 K562 TF pool 13d single-feature cells, log-normalized to target_sum=10000.
output_space_description: Subtract shared control pseudobulk from GEARS predicted expression to export perturbation-level predicted_shift. The 45 atlas gene symbols (intersection of K562 h5ad and the HCC atlas) are the complete GEARS output space, not a subsample of genome-wide predictions.
scoring_note: GEARS is scored on its complete 45-atlas-gene output space. Raw Spearman values are not directly comparable to genome-wide embedding-based entrant outputs; this restriction does not prevent architecture-form or temporal-pattern comparisons.
